# viettelcloud_key_pair (Data Source)

Get a Viettel Cloud SSH key pair by ID, name, or fingerprint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lookup key pair by ID
data "viettelcloud_key_pair" "by_id" {
  id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
}

# Lookup key pair by Name
data "viettelcloud_key_pair" "by_name" {
  name = "example-key"
}

# Lookup key pair by Fingerprint
data "viettelcloud_key_pair" "by_fingerprint" {
  fingerprint = "07:6c:9a:67:c1:91:57:d1:8a:98:6c:3c:0e:a2:d7:f6"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fingerprint` (String) Fingerprint of the key pair to filter by.
- `id` (String) Key pair ID (UUID). Exactly one key pair must match.
- `name` (String) Name of the key pair to filter by.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the key pair was created (RFC3339).
- `public_key` (String) Public key material.
- `type` (String) Type of the key pair (e.g. rsa).
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the key pair was last updated (RFC3339).
